provenance.derivation: axis-aligned bounding box of the GT positions bridged into ref_map_frame with transform_independent_source.json.ref_frame_definition.survey_to_ref_matrix, intersected with the reference map AABB; GT is the raw MCD survey (world) frame trajectory (mcd_tuhh_night_09_gt.tum), reference map is the ref_map_frame cloud (tuhh_night_09_seeded.pcd, ref_map_frame = survey_to_ref_matrix @ survey frame)

derivation_inputs.rule: ref_map_frame bbox of (survey_to_ref_matrix @ raw GT positions) INTERSECT reference_map_aabb; the intersection equals the bridged GT bbox exactly because the seeded crop contains it with >= 12 m XY / 8 m Z margin
derivation_inputs.source_only_note: only the raw GT trajectory, the recorded seed bridge (survey_to_ref_matrix, itself taken from the seeded reference-map provenance) and the reference-map AABB enter this derivation; no estimate map, no residual, no point count and no voxel grid enters it
derivation_inputs.verified_crop_identity: tuhh_night_09_seeded.pcd.provenance.json crop_aabb_min/max == bridged GT bbox_min/max -/+ (12,12,8) m (checked to <1e-6 m), i.e. the seeded reference map was cropped around exactly this bridged GT box
derivation_inputs.verified_samples_inside: 1833/1833 bridged GT samples inside this aabb; 21/1833 only for the raw survey-frame GT coordinates (the frame mixing of the superseded artifact)

provenance.notes: FROZEN AUTHORITATIVE ROI (status FROZEN_AUTHORITATIVE, 2026-09-30). Author B1bFixROI derived it to correct a FRAME INCONSISTENCY in roi_authoritative_mcd_tuhh_night_09.json: that artifact's XY min corner equals the RAW GT bbox in the MCD survey frame (roi_generation_record.gt_bbox == survey provenance gt_path_bbox = [-14.046671723,-0.215759547,-1.745827057]) while its XY max corner equals the ref_map_frame reference-map AABB (roi_generation_record.reference_map_bounds == tuhh_night_09_seeded.pcd bbox_out max [11.999822616577148,12.006364822387695,10.003280639648438]); those two corners live in different frames, so the box is not a GT-intersect-coverage region and 84/1833 bridged GT samples (vs 189/1833 raw survey-frame samples) fall inside it. Here BOTH corners are computed in reference_map_frame, the frame the estimator is evaluated in, by the SAME rule as the original derivation. Cross-check from the reference-map provenance itself: tuhh_night_09_seeded.pcd.provenance.json crop_aabb_min = [bridged GT min - (12,12,8)] and crop_aabb_max = [bridged GT max + (12,12,8)] exactly, i.e. the seeded reference map was cropped around precisely this bridged GT box, and the box lies >=12 m inside the reference coverage on every side. NO z expansion is required: the plain rule z = bridged GT z extent [-0.414, 3.407] already yields denominators far above the 1000 minimum (fork-smoke 59641, replay_2_fork 63192 on the frozen 0.25 m sampling grid); the z padding in the old artifact was compensating for the cross-frame XY shrink. Independence: only GT, the bridge matrix and the reference map AABB enter; no estimate map and no residual enters, so independent_of_estimate and independent_of_error both hold. The superseded frame-inconsistent artifact is left in place with its own provenance intact (see provenance.supersedes).
provenance.source: dataset GT trajectory valid support ∩ reference map coverage, both in reference_map_frame

supersedes.preserved_prior_sha256_note: hash of the original bytes of the superseded artifact; it is the value the historical controlled-A/B results recorded as inputs.roi_sha256 (those result files are NOT rewritten)
supersedes.reason: FRAME-INCONSISTENT: XY min corner in the MCD survey (world) frame, XY max corner in reference_map_frame; Z padding compensated for the cross-frame XY shrink. Measured: 84/1833 bridged GT samples (189/1833 raw survey-frame samples) inside.
